description: The reference rewritten so it commits to the opposite of several graded items (departing entities linger dimmed; navigation keys override focused controls; fully scaffolded projects are re-scaffolded from templates; one repair attempt, then success is reported with known issues), consistently across artifacts. The design also adopts react-router-dom and opens the sample in present mode, contradicting two simulated-user answers in conversation.jsonl.

contradicted_items.change: Departing entities stay on stage at reduced opacity until their section ends.
Navigation keys are captured at the window level and advance even while a control has focus.
Detection compares anchors with the template snapshot and treats any difference as stale.
A fully scaffolded project has its build setup and scene kit overwritten from templates.
One repair attempt, then completion is reported with failing checks listed as known issues.

planted_fidelity_contradictions.change: Routing uses react-router-dom (layout, Routing + registry, Decision 3, dependency set, migration plan).

notes: INV-094 is expected missing even in the reference: the only commitment to cleaning up preview processes is in test-plan.md (E2E-002), and coverage never credits a test-plan-only mention.

INV-118 is expected partial in the reference: design Decision 5 and its drift risk keep the template snapshot in sync, but enforcement only catches drift that breaks rendering; the file-parity check appears only in test-plan.md (INT-001).
Exchange 4 (880 × 380) and both approvals are respected; they are fidelity negatives.
Borderline, expected met: INV-051. The partial-scaffold scenario still leaves present anchors undisturbed, although the stale-template detection rule sits in tension with it.
The two answers were given in response to direct questions, so they are not disclosure leaks.
